ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
B3-2, Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 28-E in the area bound by:

a line 73.1 feet north of and parallel to East 119 Street; the alley next east of
and parallel to South Michigan Avenue; a line 49.1 feet north of and parallel to
East 119!" Street; and South Michigan Avenue;

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

LEE Geb soba

Anthony Beale

Alderman, 9" Ward

Common Address:
11853 S. Michigan Avenue
